Name: Sensor death and frozen traffic telemetry
Description: A downtown traffic counter freezes during rush hour while an industrial temperature sensor abruptly dies.
Expected: Twin: DTN-TRF-01 holds its pre-fault traffic value and IND-TMP-01 reports null with status FAILED. A STUCK fault reports status OK in the current Twin contract; Guardian independently detects the lack of variance.
Expected: Guardian: The scenario adapter detects repeated frozen values and the missing temperature packet in the same simulation step, marks both streams UNTRUSTED, and quarantines both sensors.
Expected: Brain: Ignores both quarantined streams and reads the compatible backup IND-TMP-02 for its fallback decision.
How to verify: Inspect both Twin readings, the Guardian isolation events, and the Brain backup-feed event in logs/scn-03-*.log. Guardian/Brain decisions are emitted by deterministic scenario adapters.
